sentences.text:
By way of present application, the appellant seeks suspension of sentence imposed in Case No.
714/2021 arising out of Fir No. 106/2021 registered under Sections 376(2)(n) Ipc at P.S. Maurice
Nagar, during the pendency of appeal.

2.  Learned counsel for the appellant submits that vide the impugned judgment of conviction dated 14.12.2023, the appellant has been convicted under Section 376 (1) IPC and vide the impugned order on sentence dated 08.02.2024, the appellant has been directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 7 years along with payment of fine of Rs.10,000/- in default whereof, the appellant has been directed to further This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/07/2024 at 07:11:11 undergo simple imprisonment for a period of 3 months.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant has invited attention of this Court to the testimony of prosecutrix, wherein in her cross-examination, she has admitted that prior to meeting the applicant,
she was already married in the year 2015 to one Rahul with whom she had not obtained divorce,
even at the time of registration of the present FIR.

Learned counsel states that as per the statement Raj Pal Singh Yadav vs State Of Nct Of Delhi on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131008753/
1 of prosecutrix, the appellant had entered into physical relations with her and thereafter, he had not kept his promise to marry.

sentences.text: 4. Learned APP for the State states that the prosecutrix was duly served with the present application; however, she has chosen not to appear and in this regard, I.O. has also recorded the statement of the prosecutrix.

5. Without commenting upon the contentions raised by learned counsel for the appellant, and at the same time considering the testimony of the prosecutrix, it is directed that the sentence of appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of appeal on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court/link MM/Jail Superintendent and subject to the following further conditions:-
(i) The appellant shall provide his mobile number to the I.O., on which he shall remain available during the pendency of the present appeal.
(ii) The appellant shall regularly appear before the Court as and when the appeal is taken up for hearing.
(iii) In case of change of residential address or contact details, the appellant shall promptly inform the same to the concerned I.O. as well as to this Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/07/2024 at 07:11:11 6.
The application is disposed of in the above terms.

7. Let a copy of this order be communicated to the concerned Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.
8.
I.O. shall also bring into notice of the prosecutrix the order passed today.
Dasti MANOJ KUMAR OHRI, J JULY 15, 2024 ga
